name: mirror-platform
description: Workspace joining Codex, ChromaBridge, and Mirror Runtime without collapsing their boundaries.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir chromabridge/sdk build && pnpm --dir mirror-runtime build && pnpm --dir chromabridge build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir chromabridge/sdk test && pnpm --dir mirror-runtime test && pnpm --dir codex/backend test
